audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim love-obedience, land-rain, second-Shema paragraph, and blessing-curse discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for eyewitness generation, Egypt and wilderness memory, Dathan/Abiram judgment, land dependent on rain, Divine care, second paragraph of Shema, ecological consequence, teaching/signs, territorial promise, and Gerizim/Ebal blessing-curse ceremony.

verses.restored: You shall love YHWH your Divine and keep his charge, statutes, judgments, and commands all days.

familiar.text: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

modern.text: You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.

original.text: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְחֻקֹּתָ֧יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֛יו וּמִצְוֺתָ֖יו כָּל הַיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: Know today—for not with your children who did not know and did not see discipline/instruction of YHWH your Divine, his greatness, strong hand, and outstretched arm—

familiar.text: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

modern.text: Know this day that it is not your children who have known and seen the discipline of the LORD your God: His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm;

original.text: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֮ הַיּוֹם֒ כִּ֣י לֹ֣א אֶת בְּנֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יָדְעוּ֙ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא רָא֔וּ אֶת מוּסַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת גָּדְל֕וֹ אֶת יָדוֹ֙ הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּזְרֹע֖וֹ הַנְּטוּיָֽה

verses.restored: and his signs and works he did in midst of Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and all his land,

familiar.text: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

modern.text: the signs and works He did in Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and all his land;

original.text: וְאֶת אֹֽתֹתָיו֙ וְאֶֽת מַעֲשָׂ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם וּלְכָל אַרְצֽוֹ

verses.restored: and what he did to army of Egypt, its horses and chariots, how he caused waters of Sea of Reeds to flow over their faces when they pursued after you, and YHWH destroyed them until this day,

familiar.text: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;

modern.text: what He did to the Egyptian army and horses and chariots when He made the waters of the Red Sea engulf them as they pursued you, and how He destroyed them completely, even to this day;

original.text: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְחֵ֨יל מִצְרַ֜יִם לְסוּסָ֣יו וּלְרִכְבּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵצִ֜יף אֶת מֵ֤י יַם סוּף֙ עַל פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם בְּרָדְפָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְאַבְּדֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: and what he did for you in wilderness until you came to this place,

familiar.text: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;

modern.text: what He did for you in the wilderness until you reached this place;

original.text: וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר עַד בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram sons of Eliab son of Reuben, how earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, their households, tents, and every living thing at their feet, in midst of all Israel.

familiar.text: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

modern.text: and what He did in the midst of all the Israelites to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, their households, their tents, and every living thing that belonged to them.

original.text: וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְדָתָ֣ן וְלַאֲבִירָ֗ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָב֮ בֶּן רְאוּבֵן֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּצְתָ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת פִּ֔יהָ וַתִּבְלָעֵ֥ם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת אָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם בְּקֶ֖רֶב כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: For your eyes are the ones seeing all great work of YHWH that he did.

familiar.text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.

modern.text: For it is your own eyes that have seen every great work that the LORD has done. God’s Great Blessings (Joshua 1:1–9)

original.text: כִּ֤י עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֶת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַגָּדֹ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: You shall keep all command I command you today, so you may be strong and enter and possess land where you are crossing to possess it,

familiar.text: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;

modern.text: You shall therefore keep every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and possess the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת כָּל הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: and so you may lengthen days upon ground YHWH swore to your fathers to give to them and their seed, land flowing with milk and honey.

familiar.text: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

modern.text: and so that you may live long in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

original.text: וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֛ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם וּלְזַרְעָ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ

verses.restored: For land where you are entering to possess it is not like land of Egypt from which you came, where you sowed your seed and watered it by foot like garden of vegetables.

familiar.text: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

modern.text: For the land that you are entering to possess is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you sowed your seed and irrigated on foot, like a vegetable garden.

original.text: כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה בָא שָׁ֨מָּה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ לֹ֣א כְאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ הִ֔וא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצָאתֶ֖ם מִשָּׁ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּזְרַע֙ אֶֽת זַרְעֲךָ֔ וְהִשְׁקִ֥יתָ בְרַגְלְךָ֖ כְּגַ֥ן הַיָּרָֽק

verses.restored: But land where you are crossing to possess is land of mountains and valleys; from rain of heavens it drinks water,

familiar.text: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

modern.text: But the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks in the rain from heaven.

original.text: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֨מָּה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ אֶ֥רֶץ הָרִ֖ים וּבְקָעֹ֑ת לִמְטַ֥ר הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם תִּשְׁתֶּה מָּֽיִם

verses.restored: a land YHWH your Divine seeks/carefully attends; eyes of YHWH your Divine are continually upon it, from beginning of year to end of year.

familiar.text: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

modern.text: It is a land for which the LORD your God cares; the eyes of the LORD your God are always on it, from the beginning to the end of the year.

original.text: אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ דֹּרֵ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ תָּמִ֗יד עֵינֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ מֵֽרֵשִׁית֙ הַשָּׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד אַחֲרִ֥ית שָׁנָֽה

verses.restored: It shall be, if you diligently listen to my commands that I command you today, to love YHWH your Divine and serve him with all your heart and all your soul/life,

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

modern.text: So if you carefully obey the commandments I am giving you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעָבְד֔וֹ בְּכָל לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁכֶֽם

verses.restored: then I will give rain of your land in its season, early rain and latter rain, and you shall gather your grain, new wine, and oil.

familiar.text: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

modern.text: then I will provide rain for your land in season, the autumn and spring rains, that you may gather your grain, new wine, and oil.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I will give grass in your field for your livestock, and you shall eat and be satisfied.

familiar.text: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

modern.text: And I will provide grass in the fields for your livestock, and you will eat and be satisfied.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ

verses.restored: Guard yourselves lest your heart be deceived and you turn aside and serve other gods and bow to them,

familiar.text: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

modern.text: But be careful that you are not enticed to turn aside to worship and bow down to other gods,

original.text: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: and anger of YHWH burn against you and he shut heavens so there is no rain and ground does not give produce, and you perish quickly from good land YHWH gives you.

familiar.text: And then the LORD’s wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

modern.text: or the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you. He will shut the heavens so that there will be no rain, nor will the land yield its produce, and you will soon perish from the good land that the LORD is giving you. Remember God’s Words

original.text: וְחָרָ֨ה אַף יְהוָ֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall set these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul/life, bind them as sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

familiar.text: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

modern.text: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on way, when you lie down, and when you rise.

familiar.text: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

modern.text: Teach them to your children, speaking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

original.text: וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֨ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: You shall write them upon doorposts of your house and upon your gates,

familiar.text: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

modern.text: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates,

original.text: וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: so your days and days of your children may multiply upon ground YHWH swore to your fathers to give them, as days of heavens upon earth.

familiar.text: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

modern.text: so that as long as the heavens are above the earth, your days and those of your children may be multiplied in the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.

original.text: לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: For if you diligently keep all this command I command you to do, to love YHWH your Divine, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him,

familiar.text: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

modern.text: For if you carefully keep all these commandments I am giving you to follow—to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him—

original.text: כִּי֩ אִם שָׁמֹ֨ר תִּשְׁמְר֜וּן אֶת כָּל הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָ֑הּ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם לָלֶ֥כֶת בְּכָל דְּרָכָ֖יו וּלְדָבְקָה בֽוֹ

verses.restored: then YHWH will dispossess all these nations from before you, and you shall possess nations greater and mightier than you.

familiar.text: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

modern.text: then the LORD will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations greater and stronger than you.

original.text: וְהוֹרִ֧ישׁ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת כָּל הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִכֶּֽם

verses.restored: Every place sole of your foot treads shall be yours, from wilderness and Lebanon, from river, river Euphrates, as far as western sea shall be your border.

familiar.text: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

modern.text: Every place where the sole of your foot treads will be yours. Your territory will extend from the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the Western Sea.

original.text: כָּל הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה מִן הַמִּדְבָּ֨ר וְהַלְּבָנ֜וֹן מִן הַנָּהָ֣ר נְהַר פְּרָ֗ת וְעַד֙ הַיָּ֣ם הָֽאַחֲר֔וֹן יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֻלְכֶֽם

verses.restored: No man shall stand before you; YHWH your Divine will put dread of you and fear of you upon face of all land where you tread, as he spoke to you.

familiar.text: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

modern.text: No man will be able to stand against you; the LORD your God will put the fear and dread of you upon all the land, wherever you set foot, as He has promised you. A Blessing and a Curse

original.text: לֹא יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִ֖ישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם פַּחְדְּכֶ֨ם וּמֽוֹרַאֲכֶ֜ם יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם עַל פְּנֵ֤י כָל הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדְרְכוּ בָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: See, I set before you today blessing and curse:

familiar.text: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

modern.text: See, today I am setting before you a blessing and a curse—

original.text: רְאֵ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם בְּרָכָ֖ה וּקְלָלָֽה

verses.restored: blessing, if you listen to commands of YHWH your Divine that I command you today;

familiar.text: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

modern.text: a blessing if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you today,

original.text: אֶֽת הַבְּרָכָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְע֗וּ אֶל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: and curse, if you do not listen to commands of YHWH your Divine and turn aside from way I command you today, to go after other gods you have not known.

familiar.text: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

modern.text: but a curse if you disobey the commandments of the LORD your God and turn aside from the path I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

original.text: וְהַקְּלָלָ֗ה אִם לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יְדַעְתֶּֽם

verses.restored: It shall be, when YHWH your Divine brings you into land where you are entering to possess it, you shall put blessing upon Mount Gerizim and curse upon Mount Ebal.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

modern.text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֶת הַבְּרָכָה֙ עַל הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים וְאֶת הַקְּלָלָ֖ה עַל הַ֥ר עֵיבָֽל

verses.restored: Are they not across Jordan, beyond way of sunset, in land of Canaanite dwelling in Arabah opposite Gilgal, beside oaks of Moreh?

familiar.text: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

modern.text: Are not these mountains across the Jordan, west of the road toward the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah opposite Gilgal near the Oak of Moreh?

original.text: הֲלֹא הֵ֜מָּה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן אַֽחֲרֵי֙ דֶּ֚רֶךְ מְב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּעֲרָבָ֑ה מ֚וּל הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל אֵ֖צֶל אֵלוֹנֵ֥י מֹרֶֽה

verses.restored: For you are crossing Jordan to enter and possess land YHWH your Divine gives you; you shall possess it and dwell in it.

familiar.text: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

modern.text: For you are about to cross the Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you. When you take possession of it and settle in it,

original.text: כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖הּ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם בָּֽהּ

verses.restored: You shall keep to do all statutes and judgments I set before you today.

familiar.text: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

modern.text: be careful to follow all the statutes and ordinances that I am setting before you today.

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם

translation_notes: The chapter addresses an eyewitness generation and uses communal memory to ground responsibility; it must not turn descendants into targets of inherited blame.
Dathan and Abiram's household destruction is recalled without resolving collective-punishment concerns raised in Numbers 16 and 26.
The land's dependence on rain creates ecological vulnerability and covenant attention, but drought must not be simplistically blamed on individual sin or used against climate-disaster victims.
Verses 13-21 form the second paragraph of the Shema in Jewish liturgy and must be honored within living Jewish practice without supersession or appropriation.
Love, service, teaching, tefillin, and mezuzah practices remain embodied covenant memory.
The expansive territorial promise and imposed dread are ancient conquest rhetoric and cannot function as modern borders or authorization for displacement.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 11 to blame drought, famine, climate disaster, or household tragedy on victims; to appropriate Jewish prayer; or to justify territorial expansion and fear-based rule. Center love, teaching, ecological humility, daily remembrance, and the ethical choice set before the community.
